_extraction_note: ATI's 10-K narrative is dominated by COMMERCIAL aerospace (jet engines, ~60% of HPMC) plus capacity expansions (Albany OR, Richland WA). Defense exposure is described in GENERIC terms only — naval nuclear products, military jet engines, fixed wing and rotorcraft products, armor — with NO named Pentagon Program Elements, NO named PE numbers, NO program-of-record specificity. This is the opposite extreme of the YSS/IONQ pattern: ATI does not load its forward narrative on specific DoD programs, so the J-Book divergence pattern has limited extraction surface here. Most J-Book-grounded claims must be inferred from generic platform mentions (jet engines → F-35/F119/F414; naval nuclear → Columbia/Virginia; rotorcraft → V-22/CH-53K).
